plan.notes: Official UNO catalog Four Year Plan for the BS in Psychology (College of Arts and Sciences). Semester subtotals (15/16/16/16/15/15/15/12) and the 120 total (catalog shows 120-121; recorded at minimum) match the published plan. Blank cells in the published grid are recorded as labeled choice slots; per the catalog requirements these accommodate 12 hours of PSYC electives (3000/4000 level), a 3-hour psychology laboratory (or 6-hour senior thesis), college breadth (minor/second major/additional gen eds), and free electives. PSYC 4890 Senior Assessment (0 cr) is listed in both senior semesters in the catalog grid and is recorded twice with allow_repeated_courses. Plan is a suggested roadmap, not a contract; students must meet with an advisor.
